remarks: This beautifully updated and spacious townhouse offers nearly 2,000 square feet of stylish living in the heart of Stamford's vibrant downtown, tucked within the sought-after Pinewood Estates community. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 2.5 baths across three thoughtfully designed levels, the home seamlessly blends comfort and modern upgrades. The fully remodeled kitchen boasts custom white shaker cabinetry with elegant gold hardware, quartz countertops, under-cabinet lighting, a farmhouse sink, and premium stainless steel appliances. The open-concept main level is ideal for entertaining, highlighted by gleaming hardwood floors, a chic half bath, and a sun-drenched living and dining area with a cozy wood-burning fireplace and sliding doors leading to a private balcony. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with its own balcony and a brand new, beautifully renovated en-suite bath. A second generously sized bedroom and full bathroom complete the upper level. New wide-plank vinyl flooring enhances both the second floor and the finished lower level, which offers flexible space for a home office, family room, or guest area, along with laundry and private garage access. Enjoy community amenities including a sparkling in-ground pool, pool house, and ample guest parking. All just steps from Stamford's top restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, and parks. Minutes to Metro North train to NYC this home offers the ideal blend of space, style, and convenience.
